title: Penny joins CityUHK Green Week fireside chat
description: Prof. Penny Han joined the public seminar on Climate Change & Antarctic Research as a fireside chat panelist at City University of Hong Kong.

title: Invited talk at Hohai University
description: Penny presented “Microbial Nitrogen Cycling under Environmental Change: From Grasslands to Groundwater and Coastal Ecosystems” at the College of Geography and Remote Sensing, Hohai University, Nanjing.

title: A new PhD chapter begins
description: Welcome to Linao Zhu, Zhengyao Hu, and Fangyi Liao as they begin their PhD journeys. Wishing them every success in their research!

title: HAN Lab research at ISME20
description: Penny presented “Ecophysiology and niche adaptation of comammox Nitrospira in acidic agricultural soils” at the 20th International Symposium on Microbial Ecology in Auckland, New Zealand.

title: Yunqiu presents at the Summer School of Future Ocean
description: Yunqiu Xu attended the 2026 Summer School of Future Ocean and shared her research in a poster presentation.

title: Sustainable cities in a changing climate
description: Representing CityUHK, Penny spoke on the Cities and Communities Panel at the Global Sustainable Development Congress in Jakarta. The discussion explored extreme weather and urban resilience; related SEE research was featured in Times Higher Education.

title: Professor Lisa Stein visits HAN Lab
description: We welcomed Professor Lisa Stein to HAN Lab from 2 to 6 May 2026 for a distinguished lecture and discussions with colleagues.

title: Professor Graeme Nicol visits HAN Lab
description: We welcomed Professor Graeme Nicol to HAN Lab from 28 to 31 May 2026 for a distinguished lecture and discussions with colleagues.

title: Invited talk on Antarctic coastal soils
description: Penny presented “Preliminary Exploration of Diazotrophic Community Characteristics in Antarctic Coastal Soils” at the 14th National Symposium on Geomicrobiology of the Chinese Society for Microbiology in Lanzhou.

title: Welcome, Yirui!
description: Yirui Su joined HAN Lab as a visiting PhD student. We look forward to working together.

title: Welcome, Weifu and Boyu!
description: Dr. Weifu Yan and Dr. Boyu Peng joined HAN Lab as postdoctoral researchers.

title: Penny discusses the High Seas Treaty on RTHK
description: Prof. Penny Han joined an RTHK Radio discussion on the High Seas Treaty and ocean protection, alongside Xu Yuan of CUHK and Yau Wing-kwong of the Environmental Association.

title: Penny joins NSFC Innovative Research Group (Category A) project review at Tianjin University
description: Prof. Penny Han of CityUHK participated as an invited expert in the annual progress review of the NSFC Innovative Research Group (Category A) project “Environmental Geochemistry of Metal Stable Isotopes”, led by Prof. Jiubin Chen at Tianjin University. The meeting brought together experts and project members to discuss research progress and future directions.

title: Rethinking nitrification at Shenzhen University
description: Penny gave an invited talk, “The Comammox Key: Rethinking Nitrification”, at the Institute for Advanced Study, Shenzhen University.

title: Invited talk at HKUST (Guangzhou)
description: Penny presented “Redrawing the Map of the Nitrogen Cycle: The Comammox Process and Its Cross-Disciplinary Implications” at the Earth, Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences (EOAS) Thrust, HKUST (Guangzhou).

title: Welcome, Yunqiu!
description: Yunqiu Xu joined HAN Lab as a research assistant. Welcome to the group!

title: Penny speaks at the ISF Microbiology Symposium II
description: Penny gave an invited talk at Microbiology Symposium II, held at The Independent Schools Foundation (ISF) Academy.

title: National Conference on Environmental Geochemistry
description: Penny attended the 9th National Conference on Environmental Geochemistry in Guangzhou.

title: Invited talk at the 1st ISME Asia Forum
description: Penny presented “Comammox Nitrospira-Driven Nitrification in Antarctic Soils” at the joint conference of the 1st ISME Asia Forum and the 2025 Annual Academic Meeting of the Chinese Association for Microbial Ecology, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou.

title: National Symposium on Environmental Microbiology
description: Penny attended the 26th National Symposium on Environmental Microbiology at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai.

title: Supporting marine science education in Hong Kong
description: Representing CityUHK, Penny attended the launch ceremony and first Ocean Classroom of the 15th National Marine Knowledge Competition Hong Kong contest, hosted by CUHK.

title: Keynote on Antarctic microbial nitrogen cycling
description: Penny gave an invited keynote, “Microbial Processes of Nitrogen Cycle in Antarctic Nearshore Terrestrial Ecosystems”, at the 13th Geomicrobiology Symposium of the Chinese Society for Microbiology in Mianyang.
